```{=html}
<pre class="whoami"><span class="prompt">$</span> <span id="whoami-cmd"></span></pre>
<pre class="whoami" id="whoami-out" hidden>Hi! I'm <span class="name">Martin Frigaard</span>.

I'm a Senior Application Developer at BioMarin Pharmaceutical. I like to
develop Shiny applications, R packages, and create training materials and
workshops on data management, visualizations, and reproducible research.

This is my personal blog where I write about projects I'm currently working
on (or topics I'm thinking about). Thanks for visiting!</pre>
<script>
(() => {
  const cmd = "whoami", el = document.getElementById("whoami-cmd");
  let i = 0;
  const t = setInterval(() => {
    el.textContent = cmd.slice(0, ++i);
    if (i === cmd.length) {
      clearInterval(t);
      setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById("whoami-out").hidden = false; }, 200);
    }
  }, 160);
})();
</script>
```
